title: Optimal Self-Consistency for Efficient Reasoning with Large Language Models
authors_zh: Austin Feng；Marius Alonso；Ambroise Odonnat；Vasilii Feofanov；Ievgen Redko
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A global self-consistency sampler that reallocates chain-of-thought calls toward uncertain questions without updating the model.
Blend-ASC 在全局样本预算下按答案计数置信度把下一次 CoT 采样分给最不确定的问题，最后以经验众数输出答案。
why: It makes repeated-answer counts and allocation history central Track 5 data objects while clearly separating inference-time scaling from post-training data construction.
inclusion_reason: It makes repeated-answer counts and allocation history central Track 5 data objects while clearly separating inference-time scaling from post-training data construction.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Self-consistency (SC) samples several chain-of-thought responses for one question and returns the most frequent normalized answer. Its decision boundary is the empirical mode, not an external correctness check: if the model's true answer is not the mode of its response distribution, additional samples converge toward the wrong answer. Uniform SC also spends the same number of calls on questions whose answer margins differ substantially.

The ICML 2026 paper studies how SC error scales per question and across datasets, then asks how a fixed global sample budget should be distributed. The relevant data object for this track is therefore not a new training corpus but a test-time collection of question-indexed response traces, final-answer counts, top-two margins, confidence scores, and allocation decisions. The official arXiv v2 paper is the primary source; no official code, cached generations, or allocation log was confirmed, so the card is L4-ready as a documented recipe and scaling study rather than as a reusable trace release.

Self-consistency（SC）对同一道题采样多条 chain-of-thought 响应，并返回归一化答案中出现次数最多者。它的判定边界是经验众数，而不是外部正确性检查：若真实答案并非模型响应分布的众数，增加采样只会更稳定地收敛到错误答案。统一分配的 SC 还会给答案间隔差异很大的问题投入相同调用次数。

这篇 ICML 2026 论文研究 SC 在单题和数据集层面的误差缩放规律，并进一步讨论如何在固定全局采样预算下分配调用。本 Track 关心的数据对象因此不是新的训练语料，而是按问题组织的测试时响应轨迹、最终答案计数、前两名答案间隔、置信度分数和分配决策。官方 arXiv v2 论文是主要来源；目前未确认官方代码、缓存生成结果或分配日志，因此本卡以可核查的 recipe 与 scaling study 达到 L4，而不把它描述为可复用轨迹发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper recasts SC as empirical mode estimation and plurality voting. For each question, answer counts estimate the response distribution; the gap between the two most probable answers controls how quickly the empirical mode stabilizes. Across questions with a heavy concentration of small margins, the paper derives power-law dataset behavior and contrasts uniform, fixed-allocation, and dynamic-allocation sampling.

Blend-ASC is the proposed dynamic allocator. At step t of a total budget T, it ranks every question using a linear blend of Adaptive Self-Consistency (ASC) confidence and PPR-1v1 confidence, with ASC dominating early and the asymptotically motivated PPR score dominating later. The next sample goes to the lowest-confidence question, except that questions already receiving more than 16 times the current average are excluded. After the budget is exhausted, each question's empirical mode is returned. Feedback is entirely count based; no reward model or answer-correctness verifier enters online selection. Compared with vanilla SC and heuristic ASC/ESC, the distinguishing contribution is a budget-exact, hyperparameter-free allocation rule linked to mode-estimation theory.

论文把 SC 重新表述为经验众数估计与复数投票。对每道题，答案计数用于估计响应分布；概率最高的两个答案之间的间隔决定经验众数稳定的速度。当数据集中大量问题具有小间隔时，论文推导了数据集层面的幂律行为，并比较统一分配、预先固定分配和动态分配。

Blend-ASC 是论文提出的动态分配器。在总预算 T 的第 t 步，它用 Adaptive Self-Consistency（ASC）置信度与 PPR-1v1 置信度的线性混合对所有问题排序：早期由 ASC 主导，后期逐渐转向具有渐近理论依据的 PPR 分数。下一次采样分配给置信度最低的问题，但已获得超过当前平均采样数 16 倍的问题会被排除。预算耗尽后返回每题的经验众数。反馈完全来自计数，不在在线选择中使用 reward model 或答案正确性 verifier。相较普通 SC 和启发式 ASC/ESC，其关键变化是与众数估计理论相连、严格满足预算且无需阈值超参数的分配规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are evaluation questions from GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, and GPQA-Diamond and generations from Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-MATH-7B, and Qwen2.5-32B at temperatures 0.4-1.0. To control cost, the experiments first draw 100 generations per question and treat the resulting empirical answer distribution as the simulation distribution; SC variants then resample from that multinomial rather than replaying fresh online inference. Analysis focuses mainly on aligned questions, where the correct answer is the distributional mode.

For dynamic allocation, the record for each question needs its sampled final answers, unique-answer count K, top-two counts n1 and n2, ASC confidence, PPR-1v1 confidence, blended rank, exclusion flag, and each allocation step. Blend-ASC repeatedly samples the lowest-ranked question until global budget T is reached, then outputs empirical modes. The paper evaluates the average samples needed to match SC@64 or SC@128 reducible error and reports batching variants for prompts and incoming query groups.

There is no executable environment or correctness reward in the loop; plurality and beta/count-based confidence are the selector. Fixed-allocation experiments use a smoothed convex approximation with oracle access to empirical margins. Reproduction still requires answer normalization, dataset versions, seeds, the exact aligned-question filter, cached 100-sample distributions, and code, none of which was confirmed as an official release.

输入是 GSM8K、MATH、MMLU 和 GPQA-Diamond 的评测问题，以及 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-MATH-7B 和 Qwen2.5-32B 在 temperature 0.4–1.0 下的生成结果。为控制成本，实验先为每题生成 100 条响应，将得到的经验答案分布视为模拟分布；随后各 SC 变体从该多项分布重采样，而不是重新执行在线推理。分析主要聚焦 aligned questions，即正确答案恰好是该分布众数的问题。

对动态分配而言，每题记录应包含已采样最终答案、唯一答案数 K、前两名计数 n1 与 n2、ASC 置信度、PPR-1v1 置信度、混合排序、排除标记和每一步分配。Blend-ASC 反复为排序最低的问题采样，直到全局预算 T 用尽，再输出经验众数。论文以达到 SC@64 或 SC@128 的 reducible error 所需平均样本数为评价，并报告了 prompt batching 和流式 query 分组变体。

循环中没有可执行环境或正确性奖励；选择器仅是复数投票及 beta/计数置信度。固定分配实验使用对经验间隔具有 oracle 访问的平滑凸近似。完整复现仍需要答案归一化规则、数据集版本、随机种子、aligned-question 精确筛选、100 样本缓存分布和代码；目前均未确认有官方发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports experiments across three model configurations and four benchmarks, with the main Blend-ASC comparison covering six model-dataset pairs on GSM8K, MATH, and GPQA-Diamond. In arXiv v2, Blend-ASC requires 4.8 times fewer samples than vanilla SC on average under the reported SC@64/128 matching protocol; Table 1 also shows that the factor varies materially by model, benchmark, temperature, and target. The allocator's overhead is reported as 1.8 seconds for GPQA-Diamond at a 128-sample budget, excluding generation cost.

These results support a sample-allocation claim under the paper's empirical-distribution simulation and aligned-question filter. They do not demonstrate that consensus answers are correct, that the 100 generations represent a stable production distribution, or that the stored traces are high-quality training data. The paper itself shows weaker scaling on misaligned questions and warns that multiple-choice behavior is not reliably predictable. No released run manifest was available for independent replay.

论文在三个模型配置和四个 benchmark 上进行实验；主要 Blend-ASC 比较覆盖 GSM8K、MATH 与 GPQA-Diamond 上的六个模型—数据集组合。arXiv v2 在所报告的 SC@64/128 匹配协议下给出：Blend-ASC 平均所需样本数约为普通 SC 的 1/4.8；表 1 同时显示，该倍数会随模型、benchmark、temperature 和目标误差显著变化。论文还报告在 128 样本预算下，GPQA-Diamond 上分配器自身耗时 1.8 秒，但该数字不含生成成本。

这些结果支持的是在经验分布模拟与 aligned-question 筛选条件下的样本分配主张。它们不能证明共识答案正确、100 次生成足以代表稳定生产分布，或缓存轨迹适合作为高质量训练数据。论文自身显示 misaligned questions 上缩放较弱，并指出多项选择题行为无法可靠预测。由于没有已发布的运行清单，外部目前无法独立重放这些结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Vanilla SC applies an equal sample count to every question; ASC and ESC stop individual questions with threshold or window heuristics; fixed allocation assumes prior difficulty information. Blend-ASC instead treats a batch of questions as a joint budget-allocation problem and interpolates between two rank signals during the run. This makes the output budget exact and removes the user-set stopping threshold while retaining a transition from strong low-sample behavior to an asymptotically motivated confidence rule.

The broader direction signal is the explicit elevation of allocation history and answer-count state into first-class test-time reasoning data. The theoretical analysis also separates per-question convergence from dataset-level scaling and aligned from misaligned items. The paper does not invent self-consistency, plurality voting, ASC, PPR-1v1, or beta confidence; it combines and analyzes them. Its benchmark improvements are evidence about allocation efficiency, not a quality certificate for the underlying reasoning traces. Reuse should compare against ESC/ASC under identical answer normalization and should audit whether the aligned-only evaluation changes the operational decision boundary.

普通 SC 为每题使用相同样本数；ASC 与 ESC 依赖阈值或窗口启发式停止单题；固定分配则假设预先知道难度。Blend-ASC 把一批问题视为联合预算分配任务，并在运行过程中对两个排序信号进行插值。这样既可严格用完指定预算，也无需用户设置停止阈值，同时从低样本区间表现较强的规则逐步过渡到具有渐近依据的置信度。

对本 Track 而言，更重要的方向信号是把分配历史与答案计数状态提升为一等的测试时推理数据。理论分析还区分单题收敛与数据集级缩放，以及 aligned 与 misaligned 样本。论文并未发明 self-consistency、复数投票、ASC、PPR-1v1 或 beta 置信度，而是对其组合与分析。benchmark 提升只说明分配效率，不是底层推理轨迹的数据质量证书。复用时应在相同答案归一化下与 ESC/ASC 比较，并审计仅评 aligned questions 是否改变实际决策边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main experiments simulate SC from 100 cached generations per question, so they are not a direct replay of adaptive online inference and cannot capture distribution drift, serving latency, or batching effects beyond the studied approximations. Restricting analysis to aligned questions removes exactly the cases where majority voting converges to a wrong answer. Multiple-choice benchmarks show weaker and less predictable scaling.

Answer normalization, benchmark revisions, prompt templates, random seeds, cache contents, and the exact aligned-question manifest are not released. PPR confidence depends on an estimated unique-answer count, and the 16-times-average cap is a practical heuristic. The global allocator also assumes questions can wait and share a budget, which may conflict with per-request latency. No code, raw generations, allocation logs, license, split audit, or contamination analysis was confirmed. Therefore the recipe is auditable from the paper but not yet reproducible as a released trace dataset.

主要实验从每题 100 条缓存生成结果中模拟 SC，因此不是动态在线推理的直接重放，也无法覆盖分布漂移、服务延迟或研究近似之外的 batching 影响。只分析 aligned questions 恰好排除了多数投票会稳定收敛到错误答案的情形。多项选择 benchmark 的缩放更弱且更难预测。

答案归一化、benchmark revision、prompt template、随机种子、缓存内容和 aligned-question 精确清单均未发布。PPR 置信度依赖估计的唯一答案数，16 倍平均采样上限也是实用启发式。全局分配器还假设问题能够等待并共享预算，这可能与逐请求延迟约束冲突。当前未确认代码、原始生成、分配日志、许可证、split 审计或污染分析。因此该 recipe 可由论文审计，但尚不能作为已发布轨迹数据集复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, the work suggests a compact schema for allocation-aware self-consistency: question ID and benchmark revision; prompt and decoding configuration; every candidate trace and normalized final answer; answer-frequency table; top-two margin; ASC, PPR, and blended confidence at each step; selected question; budget spent; exclusion or stopping reason; empirical mode; correctness label kept separately from consensus; and latency.

Such records could support research on schedulers, early stopping, calibration, selector training, or auditing whether compute is concentrated on genuinely ambiguous items. They should not be repurposed as positive demonstrations merely because they belong to the majority. The aligned/misaligned flag, external answer correctness, and consensus stability must remain distinct fields. Without the cached generations and allocation logs, current reuse is limited to reimplementing the recipe and testing it on independently generated traces.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace Track，这项工作给出了 allocation-aware self-consistency 的紧凑 schema：问题 ID 与 benchmark revision、prompt 与 decoding 配置、每条候选轨迹及归一化最终答案、答案频数表、前两名间隔、每一步的 ASC/PPR/混合置信度、被选问题、已用预算、排除或停止原因、经验众数，以及与共识分离保存的正确性标签和延迟。

这类记录可用于研究调度器、early stopping、校准、selector 训练，或审计算力是否真正集中到歧义样本。不能因为一条轨迹属于多数答案就把它当作正向示范。aligned/misaligned 标记、外部答案正确性与共识稳定性必须是不同字段。由于缓存生成和分配日志未发布，目前的复用仅限于重新实现 recipe，并在自行生成的轨迹上验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• SC estimates the modal answer; it does not verify correctness.
  • Blend-ASC allocates a global budget using a time-varying blend of ASC and PPR-1v1 ranks.
  • Experiments simulate allocations from 100 generations per question and focus on aligned questions.
  • The arXiv v2 headline is 4.8 times fewer samples on average, with substantial variation across settings.
  • No official code, generations, or allocation logs were confirmed.

• SC 估计答案众数，并不验证答案正确性。
  • Blend-ASC 用随预算进度变化的 ASC 与 PPR-1v1 混合排序分配全局预算。
  • 实验从每题 100 次生成形成的经验分布中模拟分配，并主要分析 aligned questions。
  • arXiv v2 报告平均减少 4.8 倍样本，但不同设置间差异明显。
  • 当前未确认官方代码、生成结果或分配日志。
